_comment: Model routing. providers = OpenAI-compatible endpoints (base_url + the NAME of the env var holding the key; never the key itself). profiles = what delegate_task can pick; model is '<provider key>/<model key>'. fallback = other profiles tried in order after repeated 429/5xx errors (empty = no fallback). Optional per-profile "backend" (kilo, opencode, ...; default: daemon.json default_backend). The daemon generates each backend's provider config from this file.

default.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B with reasoning. Normal and hard work: implement/fix/test, debugging, refactors, reviews.
default.price_note: Estimate only; check your provider's current pricing.

super.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B with reasoning. Optional cheaper alternative; add "super" to default.fallback to use it as a fallback.
